problem:
Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using the following numerical method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =(xy+{y}^{2})\cdot Δx \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy\end{aligned}
$$

If the exact solution is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)=3{x}^{2}+5x,$ find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from $x$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx.$
worked_solution:
The local truncation error (LTE) is the error made in a single step of a numerical method, when the step begins from an exact value. The LTE of a numerical method at step $n$ from $x$ with exact value ${y}_{\text{exact}}$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{n} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-{y}_{\text{new}} \\  & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-({y}_{\text{exact}}(x)+Δy).\end{aligned}
$$

We're given that the exact solution of the initial value problem is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)=3{x}^{2}+5x.$ Now, let's find the $y$-increment given by the numerical method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =(x\cdot {y}_{\text{exact}}(x)+{y}_{\text{exact}}(x)^{2})\cdot Δx \\  & =(x\cdot (3{x}^{2}+5x)+(3{x}^{2}+5x)^{2})\cdot Δx \\  & =(3{x}^{3}+5{x}^{2}+9{x}^{4}+30{x}^{3}+25{x}^{2})\cdot Δx \\  & =(9{x}^{4}+33{x}^{3}+30{x}^{2})\cdot Δx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we compute the exact value at ${x}_{\text{new}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}}) & =({y}_{\text{exact}}(x)+Δx) \\  & =3(x+Δx)^{2}+5(x+Δx) \\  & =3({x}^{2}+2x\cdot Δx+(Δx)^{2})+5x+5(Δx) \\  & =3{x}^{2}+6x\cdot Δx+3(Δx)^{2}+5x+5(Δx) \\  & =3{x}^{2}+5x+(6x+5)\cdot Δx+3(Δx)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we calculate the LTE for step $n$ starting at $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{n} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-{y}_{\text{new}} \\  & =[3{x}^{2}+5x+(6x+5)\cdot Δx+3(Δx)^{2}]-[3{x}^{2}+5x+(9{x}^{4}+33{x}^{3}+30{x}^{2})\cdot Δx] \\  & =3{x}^{2}-3{x}^{2}+5x-5x+(6x+5)\cdot Δx+3(Δx)^{2}-(9{x}^{4}+33{x}^{3}+30{x}^{2})\cdot Δx \\  & =(6x+5)\cdot Δx+3(Δx)^{2}-(9{x}^{4}+33{x}^{3}+30{x}^{2})\cdot Δx \\  & =(-9{x}^{4}-33{x}^{3}-30{x}^{2}+6x+5)\cdot Δx+3(Δx)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
